blocks.en: This book is intended to introduce its readers to the mathematical theory of partial differential equations. But to suggest that there is a "theory" of partial differential equations (in the same sense that there is a theory of ordinary differential equations or a theory of functions of a single complex variable) is misleading. PDEs is a much larger subject than the two mentioned above (it includes both of them as special cases) and a less well developed one. However, although a casual observer may decide the subject is simply a grab bag of unrelated techniques used to handle different types of problems, there are in fact certain themes that run throughout.
blocks.zh: 本书旨在向读者介绍偏微分方程的数学理论. 但是, 如果暗示偏微分方程存在一种与常微分方程理论或单复变函数理论意义相同的"理论", 就会产生误导. 偏微分方程比上述两个学科广泛得多 (它将二者都包含为特殊情形), 而且发展得还不够完善. 不过, 尽管一个随意的观察者可能认为, 这一学科不过是用于处理不同类型问题的一袋互不相关的技巧, 实际上仍有某些主题贯穿始终.

blocks.en: In order to illustrate these themes we take two approaches. The first is to pose a group of questions that arise in many problems in PDEs (existence, multiplicity, etc.). As examples of different methods of attacking these problems, we examine some results from the theories of ODEs, advanced calculus and complex variables (with which the reader is assumed to have some familiarity). The second approach is to examine three partial differential equations (Laplace's equation, the heat equation and the wave equation) in a very elementary fashion (again, this will probably be a review for most readers). We will see that even the most elementary methods foreshadow deeper results found in the later chapters of this book.
blocks.zh: 为了说明这些主题, 我们采用两种途径. 第一种是提出一组在许多偏微分方程问题中都会出现的问题 (存在性、多解性等). 为了举例说明处理这些问题的不同方法, 我们考察常微分方程理论、高等微积分和复变函数理论中的一些结果 (假定读者对这些内容已有一定了解). 第二种途径是以非常初等的方式考察三个偏微分方程 (Laplace 方程、热方程和波动方程); 同样, 对大多数读者而言, 这可能只是复习. 我们将看到, 即使最初等的方法, 也预示着本书后面各章中的更深刻结果.

blocks.en: Nonuniqueness for linear and nonlinear boundary-value problems
blocks.zh: 线性与非线性边值问题的非唯一性

blocks.en:
There are two alternatives for the solutions of the boundary-value problem \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-boundary-ode}, \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-dirichlet}, \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-neumann}.
\begin{enumerate}
\item If $\lambda=\lambda_n:=((2n+1)^2\pi^2)/4$, $n=0,1,2,\ldots$, then the boundary-value problem has a family of solutions parameterized by $A\in(-\infty,\infty)$:
\[
u_n(x)=A\sin\dfrac{(2n+1)\pi}{2}x.
\]
In this case we say $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue.
\item For all other values of $\lambda$ the only solution of the boundary-value problem is the trivial solution
\[
u(x)\equiv0.
\]
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
边值问题 \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-boundary-ode}, \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-dirichlet}, \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-neumann} 的解有以下两种情形.
\begin{enumerate}
\item 如果 $\lambda=\lambda_n:=((2n+1)^2\pi^2)/4$, $n=0,1,2,\ldots$, 那么该边值问题有一族以 $A\in(-\infty,\infty)$ 为参数的解:
\[
u_n(x)=A\sin\dfrac{(2n+1)\pi}{2}x.
\]
此时称 $\lambda$ 为特征值.
\item 对于 $\lambda$ 的所有其他取值, 该边值问题唯一的解是平凡解
\[
u(x)\equiv0.
\]
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: thm:linear-mixed-boundary-alternatives

blocks.en: Bifurcation diagram for the nonlinear boundary-value problem
blocks.zh: 非线性边值问题的分岔图
blocks.label: fig:beam-bifurcation

blocks.en: (Note that the linear ODE \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-boundary-ode} is an approximation of \eqref{eq:euler-elastica} for small $\theta$.)
blocks.zh: (注意, 当 $\theta$ 很小时, 线性常微分方程 \eqref{eq:linear-mixed-boundary-ode} 是 \eqref{eq:euler-elastica} 的近似.)

blocks.en: Solutions of this nonlinear boundary-value problem have been computed in closed form (in terms of Jacobi elliptic functions) and are probably best displayed by a \emph{bifurcation diagram} such as Figure~\ref{fig:beam-bifurcation}. This figure displays the amplitude of a solution $\theta$ as a function of the value of $\lambda$ at which the solution occurs. The $\lambda$ axis denotes the trivial solution $\theta\equiv0$ (which holds for every $\lambda$). Note that a \emph{branch} of nontrivial solutions emanates from each of the eigenvalues of the linear problem above. Thus for $\lambda\in(\lambda_{n-1},\lambda_n)$, $n=1,2,3,\ldots$, there are precisely $2n$ nontrivial solutions of the boundary-value problem.
blocks.zh: 这一非线性边值问题的解已经用闭式形式计算出来 (用 Jacobi 椭圆函数表示), 而用 Figure~\ref{fig:beam-bifurcation} 这样的\emph{分岔图}来展示这些解, 可能最为合适. 该图把解 $\theta$ 的振幅表示为出现该解时 $\lambda$ 取值的函数. $\lambda$ 轴表示平凡解 $\theta\equiv0$ (它对每个 $\lambda$ 都成立). 注意, 非平凡解的一个\emph{分支}从上述线性问题的每个特征值处发出. 因此, 当 $\lambda\in(\lambda_{n-1},\lambda_n)$, $n=1,2,3,\ldots$ 时, 该边值问题恰好有 $2n$ 个非平凡解.

blocks.en: The term stability is one that has a variety of different meanings within mathematics. One often says that a problem is stable if it is "continuous with respect to the data"; i.e., a problem is stable if when we change the problem "slightly," the solution changes only slightly. We make this precise below in the context of initial-value problems for ODEs. Another notion of stability is that of "asymptotic stability." Here we say a problem is stable if all of its solutions get close to some "nice" solution as time goes to infinity. We make this notion precise with a result on linear systems of ODEs with constant coefficients.
blocks.zh: 稳定性一词在数学中具有多种不同的含义. 人们常说, 如果一个问题"关于数据连续", 那么它就是稳定的; 即如果将问题作"微小"改变时, 解也只发生微小改变, 就称该问题稳定. 下文将在常微分方程初值问题的背景下给出这一说法的精确定义. 另一种稳定性概念是"渐近稳定性". 这里, 如果当时间趋于无穷时, 一个问题的所有解都接近某个"良好"的解, 就称该问题稳定. 我们将通过一个关于常系数线性常微分方程组的结果, 使这一概念精确化.

blocks.en: Stability with respect to initial conditions
blocks.zh: 关于初始条件的稳定性

blocks.en: In this section we assume that $\bm{F}$ satisfies the hypotheses of Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence}, and we define $\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)$ to be the unique solution of \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-dynamics}, \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-data}. We then have the following standard result.
blocks.zh: 本节假设 $\bm{F}$ 满足 Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence} 的假设, 并将 $\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)$ 定义为 \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-dynamics}, \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-data} 的唯一解. 于是有下面这个标准结果.

blocks.en:
The function $\hat{\bm{y}}$ is well defined on an open set
\[
U\subset\mathbb{R}\times D.
\]
Furthermore, at every $(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)\in U$ the function
\[
(t_0,\bm{y}_0)\mapsto\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)
\]
is continuous; i.e., for any $\epsilon>0$ there exists $\delta$ (depending on $(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)$ and $\epsilon$) such that if
\[
|(t_0,\bm{y}_0)-(\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)|<\delta,
\]
then $\hat{\bm{y}}(t,\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)$ is well defined and
\begin{equation}\label{eq:initial-data-continuity}
|\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)-\hat{\bm{y}}(t,\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)|<\epsilon.
\end{equation}
blocks.zh:
函数 $\hat{\bm{y}}$ 在一个开集上良定义:
\[
U\subset\mathbb{R}\times D.
\]
此外, 在每个 $(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)\in U$ 处, 函数
\[
(t_0,\bm{y}_0)\mapsto\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)
\]
都是连续的; 即对于任意 $\epsilon>0$, 存在 $\delta$ (依赖于 $(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)$ 和 $\epsilon$), 使得如果
\[
|(t_0,\bm{y}_0)-(\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)|<\delta,
\]
那么 $\hat{\bm{y}}(t,\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)$ 良定义, 且
\begin{equation}\label{eq:initial-data-continuity}
|\hat{\bm{y}}(t,t_0,\bm{y}_0)-\hat{\bm{y}}(t,\tilde{t}_0,\tilde{\bm{y}}_0)|<\epsilon.
\end{equation}
blocks.label: thm:initial-data-continuity
blocks.title_en: Continuity with respect to initial conditions
blocks.title_zh: 关于初始条件的连续性

blocks.en: Thus, we see that small changes in the initial conditions result in small changes in the solutions of the initial-value problem.
blocks.zh: 因此可以看到, 初始条件的微小改变会引起初值问题的解的微小改变.
